subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
If m(t) frequency modulated on a carrier with 
frequency 106 Hz with a frequency deviation constant 
kf equal to 0.5 MHz/V, the maximum instantaneous 
frequency of the modulated signal is 
 
 (a) 5 MHz 
(b) 1.5 MHz 
 
(c) 2.5 MHz 
(d) 3 MHz
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-02 (Analog Communication - AM & FM).
